caption:
"Near me" search mein upar aane ke 7 free kaam. Save karo 👇

PROFILE POORA
1. Primary category ekdum sahi
2. Timing + phone hamesha sahi (holiday hours bhi)
3. Naam, pata, number har jagah same

ACTIVE RAHO
4. Asli photos: dukaan, team, kaam
5. Har hafte ek Update post

BHAROSA
6. Har customer se review maango (sirf khush walon se nahi, sabse)
7. Har review ka jawab do, achha ho ya bura

Google khud kehta hai: local ranking relevance, distance aur prominence se hoti hai. Inme se jo aapke haath mein hai, wo ye 7 kaam hain.
